_readme: Copy to candidate_facts.json and fill in (or run /setup in Claude Code). These are the ONLY facts and answers the agents may use on applications and recruiter replies, so keep them true and matching your resume. candidate_facts.json is gitignored.
name: Jordan Example
_answers_confirmed: Set to true only after you have checked every answer below. /setup does this with you; applications won't start until it is true.
_answers: Standard answers to the questions most application forms ask. Leave a value empty only if you never want it answered automatically; the agent will then stop and ask you.

answers.work_authorization: Yes, I'm authorized to work in the US.
answers.sponsorship: No, I don't need sponsorship now or in the future.
answers.relocation: Open to relocation, on-site or hybrid.
answers.background_check: Yes, I consent to a background check.
answers.interview_availability: Please share a few times that work for you.

highlights: Replace with one true resume bullet, e.g. 'Owned the roadmap for a B2B SaaS product'
Add one line per result you want the agents to be able to quote
never_say: words or claims the agents must never use, e.g. a tool you haven't used
